subject: Shape with one factor, color with another

messages.author: 96b171d2e941ddba
messages.subject: Shape with one factor, color with another
parts:
I am trying to make a plot of prediction error (dt) by flight
(flightfact). Originally, I set both the shape and color of the points
by MsgType. It worked.

But since I used letters as the symbols, I figured that I could make
time bins and color the points by the PredTime bin (tc).

library(gdata)
library(ggplot2)
colours <- c("red","black", "green", "blue","magenta",94)
shapes <- c(RF = "R", AF = "f", PH="H", PF = "P",
BA = "B", FI = "I", FF = "F", PS = "S", TC="T")

#Plot individual flight data
dfm = df
dfm = dfm[!df$MsgType=="AS",] # Eliminate AS messages
dfm = dfm[as.numeric(dfm$PredTime) < 60.0,]
dfm$tc= as.factor(floor(dfm$PredTime/10.0)) # get 10-minute bin
dfm$flightfact = drop.levels(dfm$flightfact)
outfile = paste(base, airport, "/", airport, "byFlight", date,
".pdf", sep="")
pdf(file=outfile, width=14, height=8, par(lwd=.5))

title=paste("Data by flight and Message Type for ", airport, " the
week of ", date, sep="")
pp = qplot(as.numeric(flightfact),as.numeric(dt), data=dfm, color=tc,
main=title, ylab="Error (min)", shape=MsgType, alpha=I(1/2),
xlab="Flight", ylim=c(-20, 40)) +
scale_size(to=c(2., 2.), legend=FALSE) +
scale_shape_manual(value=shapes) +
scale_colour_manual(name=c("0", "10", "20","30","40","50"),
values = colours)
print(pp)
dev.off()

But when I run this, I get
Error in data.frame(scale$output_breaks(), I(scale$labels())) :
row names contain missing values
In addition: Warning message:
Removed 17 rows containing missing values (geom_point).

What row names is this referring to?

Sample data is at http://dl.dropbox.com/u/537118/df.zip

Thanks,
Jim

parts:
I figured this out. The problem is that the plot fails if the data set is missing any of the factors. So it seems I must generate the shapes and colours by looking at the content of each data set I process. Or is there some NA switch that will solve this issue?
